gallery.alt: Rows of prawn canapés on cubes of mango, each held by a knotted bamboo pick, set out on a wooden board.
Rows of small dessert glasses topped with heart-shaped biscuits and edible flowers, alongside chocolate brownie bites, on clear glass serving trays.
A wooden sharing board with sliced cured meats, a dish of houmous, a chicken and green pepper skewer and a bowl of green olives.
A white chocolate tart swirled with raspberry, with a sesame-seed tuile, raspberry coulis, two raspberries and a sprig of mint on a white plate.
Slices of grilled halloumi topped with pomegranate seeds, chopped mint, diced red chilli and a dark balsamic drizzle on a white plate.
Pieces of baklava and filo pastries, some topped with walnuts, with a strawberry and a spun-sugar decoration on a black slate.
A wooden board with battered calamari rings, prawns with garlic and a dried chilli in sauce, a dish of sliced chorizo and mushrooms, filo parcels and a small pot of herb dip.
A square white plate with crackling-topped pork belly, sliced pork tenderloin, a pulled pork cake, mashed potato, spinach and a small dish of sauce.
Rows of round canapés topped with tomato and white cheese on wooden boards, with a carved melon and red flower garnish in front.

notes: Logo: vector reconstruction (not the business's own vector file) traced from the transparent 680x410 header lockup PNG on magpiecatering.com. Each flat brand colour (purple #5f2573 'magpie', black 'catering', grey #a6a8ab arc and bird) was traced separately with potrace at 4x without ink dilation, because the standard logo_trace.py run thickened the thin 'catering' letters and left light seams inside the purple letters; render-back mean absolute difference 0.29 (0 = identical). The faint tapered tip of the grey arc ends slightly more bluntly than the original.
Reel: no own video exists (see research gaps), so the hero reel is a photo reel of six of Magpie's own published food photos with a gentle push-in; sources and order are in reel.json.

Gallery: all nine photos are Magpie's own uploads on magpiecatering.com (gallery, private fine dining and special events pages). photo-07 (hot mezze board) is cropped top and bottom to remove kitchen cloths and stacked packaging; the food is unchanged. Most originals are 750-1600 px, so the gallery cannot be sharper than that.

Excluded: alleyn-court-025.jpg (marquee dinner; shown on Magpie's Links page as partner Castle Marquees' image, authorship unclear); the waiting-team group photo (identifiable young staff and a readable vehicle number plate); the 1276x500 mezze paddle-board strip (too letterboxed); logos, venue/partner photos and stock images listed in the research gaps.
